messages:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>

Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial kickoff: MAP + acceptance timeline

Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're lining up a 3-week pilot next week and procurement needs a clear acceptance checklist and weekly checkpoints to close on dates and SSO onboarding. Can you share the MAP and proposed cadence?

Key asks from my side:
- Acceptance criteria (must/have-to-have) for production sign-off
- Who will own each test/validation on your side
- Any immediate blockers you foresee (security, infra)

Can we aim for a 30-min sync on Tue 08/18 or Wed 08/19? Tom (cc) will join from infra.

Best,
Sarah Jones
Head of Data Platforms, ACME Corp
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: MAP + acceptance timeline

Hi Sarah — thanks and excited to run this with ACME. Tue 08/18 at 11:00 PT works for us; booking now.

I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_draft_v1.2.pdf) and an acceptance checklist preview below. We'll keep the checkpoint cadence weekly (Tuesdays) during the POC; each checkpoint will include:
- Status against acceptance criteria (green/amber/red)
- Owner updates and open blockers
- Action items with owners and ETA

Acceptance checklist (summary):
1) Latency: 95th percentile tail < 250ms for targeted endpoint under the agreed synthetic load (owner: Dylan)
2) Functional: Pass 10 canonical prompts with correct structured output and tool calls (owner: Marissa)
3) Data controls: All request/response logs stored per retention policy; access controls validated (owner: Karthik)
4) Security: SSO + SCIM provisioning validated; SOC2 evidence provided (owner: Karthik)

Blockers we've flagged: SSO certificate exchange, and ACME network egress policy that may block private endpoint connectivity. We'll surface these in the kickoff and resolution owners will be assigned.

See you in the sync — I'll send calendar invite.

— Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

- Dylan completed batching changes; new 95th pctl measured at 240ms under the agreed synthetic workload (see attached map_tracker.xlsx).
- Marissa validated 9/10 canonical prompts; one prompt still failing due to downstream tool formatting — patch scheduled for 09/02.
- Karthik uploaded SOC2 artifacts to the shared drive and confirmed SSO test window for 09/01. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ACME-MAP-9821

Proposed acceptance gating for the trial (for sign-off at the end of week 3):
- All must-have functional tests pass (10/10 canonical prompts)
- Latency gate: 95th pctl <= 250ms under agreed load
- SSO provisioning: SCIM user create/update/delete works end-to-end
- Security: SOC2 artifacts received and no open critical findings

If ACME confirms these gates, we'll prepare a short acceptance runbook and checklist to execute in the final week.

Thanks — Rishi
